entities.summary: Lenore "Lee" Krasner was an American painter and visual artist active primarily in New York whose work has been associated with the Abstract Expressionist movement. Lee Krasner was a authors & novelists from Brooklyn (1908-10-27, Brooklyn–1984-06-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
